name: SHEPHERD_AS_DOOR
canonical: A shepherd seated upright in the open gateway gap of a round stone-walled sheepfold, his own body filling the entrance and blocking the only way in, shepherd's staff across his knees, calm watchful face. Behind him inside the fold a flock of sheep resting safely. Beyond, an open dusk hillside. He himself is the living door of the fold. Warm low light, reverent.
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
